witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 store inventory balance with LAGGED arrivals (ship at t-1 arrives at t); W3 non-negative inventory (demand met); W4 non-negative shipments; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE ship costs (tol 1e-6).

c7_lag.description: C7 time-alignment error: arrivals credited same-period instead of next-period. Type-legal, feasible, cheaper (late cheap shipping becomes usable); true lagged balance violated.
